case_title: BhaiKon @ Bakul Borah v. State of Assam
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to death for s.302 and life imprisonment for s.376
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction, reduced death sentence to life imprisonment and life imprisonment to 7 years
neutral_facts: The accused was prosecuted for the rape and murder of the victim. The victim, a young woman, went to a field to attend her goats and did not return home. Her father searched for her and found her dead with injuries on her chin and neck. The accused was identified as the perpetrator through the testimony of an eyewitness who claimed to have seen him and his accomplice commit the rape and murder. The accused was also found to have possessed items that were later linked to the crime. The prosecution relied on the eyewitness testimony, corroborative statements from the victim's family, and medical evidence indicating the cause of death was asphyxia due to throttling. The accused was initially sentenced to death for murder and life imprisonment for rape, but the High Court reduced the death sentence to life imprisonment and the life imprisonment to 7 years.
